Why "1 cup = X grams" depends on the ingredient

A cup measures volume; a scale measures weight. A cup of all-purpose flour weighs about 120 g, a cup of granulated sugar about 200 g, and a cup of butter 227 g. Even the same ingredient varies: flour scooped straight from the bag can weigh 20% more than flour spooned into the cup and leveled. That's why answers online disagree, and why every chart here is for one specific ingredient and says how it was measured and where the number comes from.
